meaning: 撒哈拉沙漠的某些地区
usageNote: some parts of 就是'某些地方'，不是全部哦！说话留余地的万能句型，超实用！

examples.en: Some parts of the Sahara receive almost no rainfall each year.
examples.zh: 撒哈拉沙漠的某些地区每年几乎没有降雨。

examples.en: Surprisingly, some parts of the Sahara are covered in grass and shrubs.
examples.zh: 令人惊讶的是，撒哈拉沙漠的某些地区覆盖着草和灌木。
